verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only human-facing rails: paper filing by mail, a web Online-Filing System, and a downloadable credit-card authorization form. Nothing shows a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter or bulk-filer programs, or batch providers, and nothing shows a published enrollment path. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, the filing host reset the connection, and Business Express disallows all crawling; none of this is a documented machine rail.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
